articles.title: Show HN: AgentRun: DSL to turn agents into workflows
articles.text: Hi HN, I just open sourced the DSL that our harness in grep.ai uses to turn repeatable parts of agent work into workflows. You can combine tool calls, code, Jev-powered system one decisions for things like routing and screening evidence, and agents when a step needs more investigation. Our harness uses the traces and retro notes agents leave behind when doing a job to figure out which parts can become a workflow.
